# Safa (صفا)

> A private, local app that cleans audio/video recordings — noise
> removal, silence cutting, voice/music separation, loudness, subtitles.
> Everything runs on the user's computer; nothing is uploaded. Bilingual
> English/العربية. Default app URL: http://127.0.0.1:8790

## Helping a user install

Start here — it contains the exact workflow (ask OS → ask NVIDIA → pick
method → warn about SmartScreen/Gatekeeper → usage → file locations →
troubleshooting):

- [For AI assistants (English)](README.md#for-ai-assistants)
- [للمساعدات الذكية (العربية)](README.ar.md#للمساعدات-الذكية-ai-assistants)

## Install methods by OS

- [Windows — all methods](README.md#install--windows):
  online installer (recommended), offline CPU installer, offline GPU
  spanned installer, portable CPU zip, portable GPU split 7z, PowerShell
  one-liner (`install.ps1` — checksum-verified wrapper around setup.exe),
  winget, Scoop, from source.
- [macOS — beta (Apple Silicon)](README.md#install--macos-beta-apple-silicon):
  `install.sh` one-liner, Homebrew formula, portable tarball, source.
- [Linux — beta (x86_64)](README.md#install--linux-beta-x86_64):
  `install.sh` one-liner (cpu/cuda), AUR, portable tarballs, source.
- [Docker](README.md#docker): CPU and CUDA images — always publish
  `127.0.0.1:8790:8790`, volume `/data`.
- [Offline model packs](README.md#offline-model-packs):
  `Safa-models-core-*.zip` / `Safa-models-all-*.zip` imported via
  `python -m backend.launcher models import`.

The same lists in Arabic: [التثبيت — ويندوز](README.ar.md),
[ماك](README.ar.md), [لينكس](README.ar.md), [Docker](README.ar.md).

## Using the app

- [Usage](README.md#usage): preset → drop a file → Process → Save.
- [File locations](README.md#where-things-live): installed vs portable
  data dirs (`SOUND_SYSTEM_DATA_DIR` overrides).
- [Troubleshooting](README.md#troubleshooting): port busy, model
  downloads, GPU detection, SmartScreen/Gatekeeper, antivirus.

## Key facts for assistants

- App port: **8790**; env overrides: `SOUND_SYSTEM_PORT`,
  `SOUND_SYSTEM_DATA_DIR`, `SOUND_SYSTEM_BIND_HOST` (default 127.0.0.1),
  `SOUND_SYSTEM_MODELS_DIR`.
- First-run model download: **~600 MB** core; optional models ~1.7 GB.
- GPU: NVIDIA driver ≥ 551 for CUDA 12.4 wheels; every GPU stage falls
  back to CPU automatically.
- Packages are unsigned — SmartScreen "More info → Run anyway"; macOS
  quarantine is removed from our folder only.
